Hahaha...|Beginning of Wave 36}}}} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Boomer 1''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that exploded upon its death, stunning nearby towers in its radius. It was a fairly strong enemy with an average speed. The '''Boomer 1''' appeared in [[The Heights]] during the [[SFOTH Event]]. The '''Boomer 1''' no longer spawns and has since been replaced by the [[Boomer (Legacy)|Boomer]]. ==Appearance== The '''Boomer 1''' was a bloated enemy, but similar in size to the [[Normal]]. The head and arms were light aqua green, while its torso and legs were slightly dark aqua green. It had a sad zombie drooling face. ==Strategy== *Rapid-firing towers, such as the [[Minigunner]] or [[Sentry]], can kill the '''Boomer 1''' before it reaches your towers. **The [[Commander]] can also assist in killing this enemy quicker by boosting the firerate of your towers. *The [[Demoman]] and [[Rocketeer|Rocketer]] can kill hordes of these through splash damage, preventing them from getting anywhere near your towers. **Additionally, the [[Ranger|Outlaw]] can also be used to kill the '''Boomer 1s''' from afar without the risk of being stunned. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} 1b23bd2ad145b214e9f6ce76d6f08a88.jpg|'''Boomer 1''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} Thumb1.jpg|'''Boomer 1''' on a promotional image. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Boomer 1''' was based on the ''Left 4 Dead'' zombie, the [[w:c:left4dead:The Boomer|Boomer]]. *The "''Do you get the pun?''" and "''Hahaha...''" narration that appeared for this enemy were the only narrations to be played a significant amount of time after the enemies had come out before the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]]. **The narration played when the game assumed the '''Boomer 1''' had exploded, though it could be played before or after the '''Boomer 1''' had exploded. ==Update History== *'''16 June 2019''' - [[BETA v1.1|BETA v1.1.0]] **'''Boomer 1''' added. *'''13 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.0]] **'''Boomer 1''' removed, replaced with the [[Boomer (Legacy)|Boomer]]. {{TheHeights|[[Speedy]] & [[Normal]]|Wave 3|Boomer 1|Wave 4|[[Stone Viking]]|Wave 5}} {{Normal|[[Gravekeeper]] & [[Mystery Summoner|Mystery Boss]]|Wave 35|Boomer 1|Wave 36|[[Necromancer 2]]|Wave 37}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
